MODULE: frontend/interop.py -- the evaluator-side {det,obs} -> matchable
stim.DetectorErrorModel plumbing: the exact Spitz Eq.13 pairwise p_ij + odd-parity

THREE LIVE public units, all with real for/if branch surface:
records_to_dem       -- 6 ValueError guards; kept-edge loop body vs 0-edge loop; the
edge_factor<=NUMERICAL_ZERO clamp; the p_raw<=NUMERICAL_ZERO skip
vs the p_raw<-pair_floor_abs 'negative_residual' clamp; the

and the p_raw>_MAX_EDGE_P boundary clamp; the non-finite p_ij mask.
decode_records       -- ndim / logical_index<0 / num_detectors / li>=n_obs guards + the

insert_op_after_tick -- tick out of [0,total]; t==0 insert-before vs t>=1 insert-after;
the TICK-match and seen==t both arcs.
DISCRIMINATION (the prior-batch value-vs-shape lesson): every load-bearing assert PINS a
VALUE against an INDEPENDENT from-scratch Spitz recompute (_spitz_ref -- NOT the module's
spitz_pij_exact) or the EXACT odd-parity boundary identity, or asserts DISCRIMINATION
(assert_discriminates: floor bracket, _MAX_EDGE_P clamp, logical_index column selection,
insert-after-tick off-by-one). Deterministic exact-count population cubes (no sampling) make
every pin exact to 1e-12.

stim 1.16 / pymatching 2.4), so the predicted.ndim==1 reshape arc and the shape[1]!=n_obs
guard are unreachable through the real backend; they are covered by tripping the guard via a
monkeypatched pymatching.Matching backend seam (the sanctioned extract/trip-the-seam route),
paired with the legit 2-D path property (test_L1_decode_output_contract).
The module's public constants (DEFAULT_PAIR_FLOOR_ABS, DEFAULT_PAIR_FLOOR_SIGMA) and the
private _MAX_EDGE_P are not defs => not public units; they are exercised via the unit pins.
